private_lines.Callum: You live in Leith and work as a project coordinator for a housing association. This week you're busy with a report due Friday and trying to get the flat repainted before the landlord's inspection.
private_lines.Eilidh: You live in Marchmont and work as a staff nurse at the Royal Infirmary on rotating shifts. This week you're on a run of night shifts, so your days are slow and your evenings are short.
private_lines.Rory: You live in Stockbridge and work as a software developer. This week you're back from a conference in Lisbon, catching up on email and sorting out a backlog of work.
private_lines.Shona: You live in Bruntsfield and teach a primary school class. This week is busy with marking, a parents' evening on Thursday and a class project that's gone a bit wrong.

setting: You all live in Edinburgh and met at university there, in the same flat-sharing circle. You have kept this group chat going since graduation, so you know each other's jobs, flats and habits well. Last time you were in touch, the chat was about whether a Hibs result was a fluke, with nothing to do with plans.

Callum.who: 31, man, the friend who wants everyone to meet this weekend
Callum.knows: You know Eilidh and Rory from your flatting days, and Shona from the same uni crowd. You know Eilidh works shifts at the Royal Infirmary, Rory travels for work, and Shona teaches primary school and rarely has a free evening.
Callum.texts: You start a conversation now and then, and you react with an emoji instead of replying fairly often when a message only needs a quick acknowledgement.
Callum.style: You use normal capitals and full stops and keep messages short. You add an emoji now and then, but not in every message.
ex: Anyone seen the new Hibs kit yet?
Flat's chaos, the painter has cancelled on me
Did anyone else get soaked on the walk today?
Ha, that's brilliant 😂
Work's been mental, send help
👍 that's me sorted for the report

Eilidh.knows: You know Callum from uni flatting days, and Rory and Shona from the same crowd. You know Callum is the one who organises things, Rory is always travelling, and Shona has a toddler at home now.
Eilidh.texts: You message rarely without being prompted, but you react with an emoji very often because you mostly read the chat on breaks.
Eilidh.style: You type in short, mostly lowercase messages with few full stops. You use emoji fairly often and abbreviate freely, like "omg" and "brb".
ex: omg just got off a twelve hour shift
night shift has broken me
anyone else's boiler dead this week
haha same
brb someone's buzzing at the door

Rory.knows: You know Callum from your flatting days and Eilidh and Shona from the same crowd. You know Callum keeps everyone organised, Eilidh works nights at the hospital, and Shona is the one who always has a plan for the group.
Rory.texts: You start a conversation now and then, and you react with an emoji instead of replying a bit less often than you'd like to admit, usually when you're deep in a work task.
Rory.style: You use normal punctuation and mostly lowercase in the group, with the odd "tbf" or "lol". You rarely use emoji but do now and then.
ex: Lisbon was too hot for me tbf
Jet lag has me up at 4am
lol
Fair play 👍
my flat's got mice, send help
Anyone else tried that new ramen place on Dundas Street?

Shona.knows: You know Callum, Eilidh and Rory from uni, and you're the one who always stays in touch. You know Callum is the organiser, Eilidh works nights, and Rory travels a lot for work.
Shona.texts: You message now and then without being asked, and you react with an emoji instead of replying fairly often when you're busy
Shona.style: You write in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and your messages are usually a line or two. You use emoji now and then, but not in most messages.
ex: Parents' evening tonight, so send coffee
Haha, that's fair
My class made a volcano and it went everywhere
Who's watching the football later?
I'm so tired I could cry 😅
Is the chippy on Dalry Road still open?

topic: You want to get everyone together this weekend, but nobody has said when they're free.
